detail: Check the roar timing against the aura burst, the crouched idle against walking and attacks, and the end of berserk.
done_when: a recording where the roar, aura and stance line up and the stance returns cleanly
result: Recorded cam_berserk.mp4 (side camera, berserk at 3 s, unarmed fight). Seen in stills: the roar fire burst covers the fighter for a moment, then the aura rings and lightning arcs, and the fighter crouches forward in the feral stance. Not checked: the roar pose itself (hidden by the burst), the stance on walking and attacking, and the return to normal at the end of berserk. Needs a frame-by-frame look or a quieter burst.
title: Berserk stance and roar in a real fight
